result.question: Quais municípios com mais de 500 internações aparecem simultaneamente no top-20 de volume e no top-20 de taxa de mortalidade nos estados MA e RS?
result.gold_sql: WITH top_volume AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20), top_mortalidade AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT tv.nome FROM top_volume tv WHERE tv.nome IN (SELECT nome FROM top_mortalidade) ORDER BY tv.nome;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ), ranked_internacoes AS ( SELECT municipio, estado, total_internacoes, taxa_mortalidade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY estado ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC) AS rn_internacoes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY estado ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade DESC) AS rn_taxa FROM internacoes_por_municipio ) SELECT municipio, estado FROM ranked_internacoes WHERE rn_internacoes <= 20 AND rn_taxa <= 20 ORDER BY estado, municipio;
